profile_text.body:
Box is a public company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, traded on the NYSE under the ticker BOX. The company describes itself as an intelligent content management platform that lets organizations store, share, collaborate on, and automate workflows around unstructured data such as lease agreements, finance documents, sales presentations, and employee handbooks. Its platform emphasizes enterprise-grade security, covering deep learning-based malware detection, automated data classification, granular access controls, and built-in compliance tools for standards including GDPR, HIPAA, and FINRA.

Box AI is the company's core AI product, categorized as an enterprise content AI offering that integrates with models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google to deliver real-time summaries, analysis, and recommendations across stored content. The product also covers metadata management, governance, retention policies, and compliance functions. Box AI Studio allows developers and administrators to build and customize AI agents, while a drag-and-drop workflow builder supports automated end-to-end business processes such as loan processing and employee onboarding. The company also offers AI-driven e-signature workflows, including unlimited e-signatures at no additional cost, built directly into the content platform.

Box's most recent annual revenue, reported in a 10-K filing for the period ending January 31, 2026, was approximately 1.177 billion dollars. The held facts show no active litigation on record for the company in this dataset.
